function.name: sec_company_concept
function.description: Fetch a single US-GAAP financial concept for a company directly from the SEC XBRL API. Use this when the user asks about income statement or balance sheet line items (revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, assets, liabilities, cash). Returns up to 20 most recent annual and quarterly filings for the requested concept. The cik must be looked up from the company registry.

cik.description: The company's SEC CIK number, e.g. '0001954042' for Zeekr. Look up from the company registry.

concept.description: The US-GAAP concept to retrieve. Choose based on the user's question: revenue/sales → GrossProfit or CostOfRevenue; profit → NetIncomeLoss or OperatingIncomeLoss; balance sheet → Assets or Liabilities; liquidity → CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue.
